notes.title: Archons: Arena has left Early Access
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

After a year of development, Archons: Arena has left Early Access.

The full release includes:
[list]
[*] 30 unique opponents
[*] 77 items
[*] 111 skills
[*] 7 weapon types: Sword, Shield, Blunt, Dagger, Spear, Ranged, Throwing
[*] 6 magic schools: Conjuration, Elementalism, Ether, Mentalism, Blood Magic, Life Force
[*] 6 attributes: Constitution, Agility, Intelligence, Preparation, Charisma, Specialization
[*] 2 fully-voiced shopkeepers
[/list]
The release also includes an in-game editor, allowing you to customize and extend the game to your liking. The modifications are saved in the %APPDATA% folder. There are 4 main categories that can be edited.

[h2]Items[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/49a210c0e7ccfd6fdc2e57767cb25904862d411a.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Value[/b] determines the cost of the item in shop
[*] [b]Uses[/b] determines how many rounds the item can be used before it's worn out
[*] [b]Probability[/b] determines the likelihood of the item appearing in the shop
[/list]
[h2]Cards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/9acecdf74bbbcc16c42d6611e80407e4eab6ae8f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Cost[/b] determines the energy cost to play the card
[*] [b]Probability[/b] determines the chance that the card will be played successfully
[*] [b]Single Use[/b] determines if the card can only be played once per round
[*] In order for a card to be available to the player, a Skill needs to be created that will grant the card to the player
[/list]
[h2]Skills[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/1a6c9374ab11f74cbf165118a151aaf58196639c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Category[/b] determines under which weapon/magic/attribute category the skill will appear
[*] [b]Cost[/b] determines the number of skills points required to unlock the skill
[*] [b]Requires[/b] determines which other Skills must be unlocked before the current skill can be unlocked
[*] [b]Cards[/b] determines the cards and number of copies granted to the player when the skill is unlocked
[*] [b]Instant Effects[/b] and [b]Permanent Effects[/b] provide bonuses to the player on unlock
[/list]
[h2]Opponents[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/683999ec534eedfdd30ba3704419ba2b4aaa108d.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Level[/b] determines when the opponent will start appearing in the arena, with higher level opponents only appearing in the later rounds
[*] [b]HP[/b] determines the number of hit points
[*] [b]Block[/b] determines the default block value at the start of each turn
[*] [b]Cards[/b] determines the cards and number of copies in the opponent's deck
[*] [b]Effects[/b] provide buffs/debuffs for the opponent
[*] When creating a new opponent, a single .png file may be provided for the [b]Idle Images[/b] field. If multiple images are provided, then they will be rendered in a loop at 30fps.

notes.title: Conjuration Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena. This is the last content update during Early Access before the full release in September.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
A [b]Conjurer[/b] is able to adapt to any situation, summoning the right weapons and bonuses at the right time.
[list]
[*] [b]Conjure a Weapon[/b] - conjure a weapon of choice
[*] [b]Conjure a Bonus[/b] -  conjure a bonus of choice
[*] [b]Polymorph[/b] - transform the target into something else
[*] [b]Superior Weapons[/b] - receive a superior selection of weapons during conjuration
[*] [b]Superior Bonuses[/b] - receive a superior selection of bonuses during conjuration
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Conjurer Robes[/b] - [i]armor[/i] item that reduces the energy cost of Conjuration cards.
[*] [b]Staff of Conjuring[/b] - [i]weapon[/i] item that adds a free [b]Conjure a Bonus[/b] spell to the deck
[/list]
[h3]Opponents[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Battlemage[/b] - performs strong magical attacks, occasionally conjures a permanent buff
[*] [b]Sentinel[/b] - retains block between turn, deals damage equal to the block
[/list]

notes.title: Shopkeeper Update #2
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Welcome to Dragon's Hoard, a new welcoming establishment to give you respite between your battles. Haruna, the owner of this little shop, is a dedicated and resourceful alchemist who has carved her path through hard work and determination. Running the store can be overwhelming at times but Haruna always keeps a positive attitude and tries to pass it on to her customers. She loves spending time by herself in nature, on hikes and in her flower garden. And she has a cat named Kaito, who can be a handful.

Visit Dragon's Hoard today and say hello to Haruna! You don't want to make her sad, do you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/40706af1dab08a6e2f5a21e848e7e89b1cd40338.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Shopkeeper Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Welcome to Veteran's Valor, your supply store for the Arena. Oldben is the proprietor of this establishment. As a military veteran, Oldben has seen his fair share of battles and understands the challenges and risks that come with combat. This has fueled his desire to offer guidance and support to the arena combatants who frequent his shop. He considers his shop to not be just a place of commerce, but also a haven for camaraderie and encouragement. His loyal dog, Valor, provides comfort and companionship to both Oldben and his customers. 

Now as you purchase items, learn skills, and progress through the Arena, Oldben will share his wisdom and experience to encourage you on your journey. A fully-voiced character with 800+ lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/b9c952ff7578877584ad59202af6c7d5630e2048.jpg[/img]

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena for the month of January.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
A [b]Life Force mage[/b] is a mystical practitioner attuned to the ebb and flow of vitality in the world. With a deep connection to the natural world, they possess the ability to mend wounds, dispel enchantments, and even draw sustenance from the life force of others. Their presence is a harmonious blend of healing warmth and enigmatic power, embodying the delicate balance between nurturing life and wielding the forces of arcane vitality.
[list]
[*] [b]Heal[/b] - +1 HP
[*] [b]Dispel[/b] -  clear random effect from target
[*] [b]Absorb[/b] - deal 1 unblockable, leeching damage to target
[*] [b]Health Bind[/b] - absorb 1 HP from target for X turns
[*] [b]Rejuvenation[/b] - restore all hp and heal all injuries, +3 block
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Vitamancer Robes[/b] - [i]armor[/i] item that reduces the energy cost of Life Force cards.
[*] [b]Staff of Healing[/b] - [i]weapon[/i] item that adds a free [b]Heal[/b] spell to the deck
[/list]
[h3]Opponents[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Soulthirst[/b] - performs strong magical attacks that absorb health from the player
[*] [b]Vitamancer[/b] - performs moderate magical attacks that absorb health from the player, may heal self and other opponents
[/list]

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena for the month of December.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[b]Blood Mages[/b] harness the power of their own life force to unleash devastating abilities upon their foes. It only takes a mere flick of the wrist to summon a burst of shadowy energy that damages all opponents within range, while the mage's connection to the arcane allows them to bend fate itself, granting them access to powerful abilities.
[list]
[*] [b]Splatter[/b] - deal 1 damage to all opponents, -1HP
[*] [b]Divination[/b] -  draw 3 cards, -1HP
[*] [b]Drain Vitality[/b] - deal 1 wounding damage to target, -1HP
[*] [b]Haze[/b] - stun target, -2HP
[*] [b]Burst[/b] - deal 1 unblockable damage to all opponents, -2 HP
[/list]
[h3]Opponents[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Crossbowman[/b] - performs ranged attacks that have a chance to miss but will inflict an injury when hitting the mark
[*] [b]Cultist[/b] - takes damage every turn but deals double damage every 2 turns
[/list]

notes.title: November Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena for the month of November.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
Those attuned to the [b]Ether[/b] can harness its energy to gain a strategic advantage without directly damaging the opponent. Skilled etherists assert their dominance by weaving spells that grant substantial protection from attacks, swiftly teleporting to unleash devastating strikes, stripping away the defenses of their foes, conjuring reflective wards, and even assuming an ethereal form to evade incoming assaults.
[list]
[*] [b]Barrier[/b] - gain 4 block
[*] [b]Flanking Teleport[/b] - +1 damage this turn
[*] [b]Remove Block[/b] - remove all block from target
[*] [b]Ethereal Form[/b] - 50% chance to dodge attacks
[*] [b]Reflect Ward[/b] - 50% chance to reflect damage
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Etherist Robe[/b] - [i]armor[/i] item that reduces the energy cost of Ether cards.
[*] [b]Reflect Crystal[/b] - [i]crystal[/i] item that provides 15% chance to reflect attacks.
[*] [b]Staff of Disorientation[/b] - [i]weapon[/i] item that adds a free [b]Disorient[/b] spell to the deck
[*] [b]Staff of Reflection[/b] - [i]weapon[/i] item that adds a free [b]Reflect Ward[/b] spell to the deck
[/list]
[h3]Opponents[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Spellsword[/b] - deals and blocks a moderate amount of damage, may reflect damage
[*] [b]Etherist[/b] - deals and blocks a moderate amount of damage, may reflect damage, may disintegrate items
[*] [b]Scorpion[/b] - poisonous, may perform unblockable attacks
[/list]
[h2]Presentation[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 new backgrounds
[*] 15 new sound effects
[*] 4 new visual effects
[/list]

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the Arena for this month.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[h3]Skills[/h3]
We have added the first school of magic, [b]Mentalism[/b]. These abilities are focused on playing games with your opponent's mind rather than dealing direct damage. Magic abilities cannot be used if two weapons are equipped unless you have unlocked [b]Deft Magic[/b], a new skill under the [b]Agility[/b] attribute.
[list]
[*] [b]Intuition[/b] - Choose 1 card to draw
[*] [b]Confuse[/b] - Add 1 Confusion card to target's deck
[*] [b]Disorient[/b] - 30% chance target will damage self when attacking
[*] [b]Alter Intent[/b] - Change target's intent
[*] [b]Psy Op[/b] - Deal damage equal to number of cards in hand
[/list]
[b]Charisma[/b] is a new attribute that likewise will allow fighters to play mind games with an opponent.
[list]
[*] [b]Demoralize[/b] - Reduce number of attacks by 1
[*] [b]Shout[/b] - Remove block from target
[*] [b]Taunt[/b] - +1 damage to target, -30% success chance
[*] [b]Denigrate[/b] - Clear random effect from target
[*] [b]Crowd Favorite[/b] - +1 energy
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Mentalist Robe[/b] - [i]armor[/i] item that reduces the energy cost of [b]Mentalism[/b] cards.
[*] [b] Lucky Coat [/b] - [i]armor[/i] item that adds a random effect at the start of each round
[*] [b] Cursed Crystal [/b] - [i]crystal[/i] item that adds a random negative effect at the start of each round, +25 gold at the end of the round
[*] [b] Endurance Potion [/b] - [i]potion[/i] item that provides immunity to injury for 50 turns
[*] [b] Discernment Potion [/b] - [i]potion[/i] item that provides discernment for 50 turns
[/list]
[h3]Opponents[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Mentalist[/b] - will apply negative effects, may steal cards, and perform other unconventional actions
[*] [b] Ninja [/b] - will apply negative effects, use poisonous attacks
[*] [b] Novice Mage [/b] - will do moderate attacks but has a chance to damage self
[/list]
[h2]Presentation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crowd sound effects have been added
[*] 10 new background music tracks
[*] vfx for [b]Block[/b] card
[/list]
[h2]Balance[/h2]
[h3]Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b] Rage [/b] - cost increased from 3 to 5. Adds 2 [b]Confusion[/b] cards instead of 1.
[*] [b] Composure [/b] - cost increased from 3 to 5. Adds 2 [b]Confusion[/b] cards instead of 1.
[/list]
[h3]Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b] Crush [/b] - inflicts injury in addition to previous effects
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b] Swift Dagger [/b] - cost increased from 150 to 200
[/list]

We are working on adding [b]Ether[/b] magic in November's update.

notes.title: Skills Introduction
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Today we want to take a look at skills fighter are able to learn as they gain more experience. As mentioned in one of the previous articles, each weapon has its own skill tree. Fighters may choose to focus on mastering a single weapon or experiment with several to better adapt to each opponent. In addition to weapon skills, fighter may choose to develop their attributes:
[list]
[*] Constitution - generally will help you survive more hits in a fight
[*] Agility - for those looking to avoid getting hit
[*] Intelligence - increases choices and options during a fight
[*] Preparation - allows you to fine-tune your deck
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/5d6b634bd0e91e759581aea93bcc1e8af41f3113.png[/img]
Finally, fighters may also choose to learn a [b]Specialization[/b], or even a couple. Specializations provide a permanent boost to the fighter but also come with a drawback. For example, [b]Patient[/b] fighters are able to retain unused energy between turns but also have a lower base energy pool.

notes.title: Equipment Introduction
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Today we want to take a look at the equipment available to the fighters of the arena.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
Your equipped weapons determine which cards are available to you during the fight. If you are a trained marksman but do not have a bow equipped, those cards will not be in your deck. Up to 2 weapons can be equipped at the same time. Check the previous article for a more detailed overview of various weapon types.

[h3]Armor[/h3]
Armor provides extra block each turn but at the expense of energy loss. Heavier armor provides more block but also has a greater energy penalty. Fighters can negate the energy loss by improving their [b]Armor Mastery[/b] skill. Fighters that choose not to wear armor may want to unlock [b]Light-footed[/b] specialization that increases your energy pool when not wearing armor.

[h3]Crystals[/h3]
Crystals provide persistent buffs as long as they are equipped. [b]Energy Crystal[/b] is always a favorite since it provides +1 energy to the user. Up to two crystals can be equipped at the same time.

[h3]Potions[/h3]
Potions provide temporary effects that will last the first few turns of a fight. Potions must be used prior to entering the arena and cannot be used during the fight. [b]Draw Potion[/b] will increase the number of cards drawn per turn for 5 turns, giving you more options during the opening moments.

Next time we will take a look at the fundamental aspects of fighting an opponent.

notes.title: Weapon Introduction
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Today we want to take a look at the weapons available to you in the arena. But first, a quick intro to the characters stats.
[list]
[*] [b]HP[/b] - number of hit points. By default, you will start with 5 HP. If the number falls to 0, the game is over.
[*] [b]Block[/b] - when an opponent attacks, the attack will first reduce your block points before damaging HP. Block resets to 0 at the start of each turn.
[*] [b]Energy[/b] - energy determines how many cards can be played per turn. By default, you will start with 2 energy.
[/list]
[h2]Weapons[/h2]
[h3]Sword[/h3]
The sword is a great choice for those looking to protect themselves and deal some damage. This is perhaps best exemplified by the first card in the skill tree, [b]Slash[/b]. It only costs 1 point of energy while providing 1 point of attack and block.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/0cfcc8c21ffe54e0b3e7271705ec7383a98352fb.png[/img]
[h3]Shield[/h3]
The shield is the obvious choice for increasing your defense. The skill tree also includes cards to stun the opponent or even to use your block as offensive damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/f5b35aa6012cb2c6a2132a8a8026fadc4fd752a1.png[/img]
[h3]Dagger[/h3]
Fighters equipped with the dagger are able to deal a lot of damage with little energy expenditure but have no way to defend themselves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/b062511f938aeab1512ba88c1a1648b76d8d4f2f.png[/img]
[h3]Ranged[/h3]
Ranged weapons, like a bow, offer opportunity to deal high amount of damage but at the cost of possibility of missing the attack entirely.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/1c22b2809039ecf6cbb0c4ea46b148b02df16a44.png[/img]
[h3]Spear[/h3]
Spear users are able to take advantage of the longer reach to dodge incoming attacks or damage the attacker in return.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/570db835db7ddfc2334ac46e7b6e97415b2c2346.png[/img]
[h3]Blunt[/h3]
Maces and hammers allow dealing damage against even the most armored opponents, ignoring the block and damaging HP directly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/985e0be1a98ecb52052ba815715d5cbecabce2c2.png[/img]
[h3]Thrown[/h3]
Thrown weapons offer low cost utility, allowing the fighter to quickly turn the odds in their favor, but can only be used once per round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/f0c466fed227939de8f2692cf5fd2968874cac82.png[/img]

In case you were worried, each of the weapons of course includes more than just 1 card that's been shown here. In the next article, we will take a look at other types of gear available to the fighters.

notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Archons: Arena is coming to Steam Early Access on September 13th.

The first release will include:
[list]
[*] 14 unique opponents
[*] 60 items
[*] 75 skills
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321900
